title: +EMBRACING UNCERTAINTY IN PHYSICS
description: Examines the impacts that social systems have on physics throughout time. Identifies sources of systemic oppression in physics and where inequities still exist today. Explores a future where physics culture is inclusive and equitable, and where physics is done for the good of humanity.
recommendations: Completion of a Difference, Power, and Oppression Foundations course; Concurrent enrollment in 300-level PH courses; Critical thinking, reasoning, and synthesis skills
attribute_description: Core Education - Difference, Power, & Oppression: Advanced (CSDP)
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: WF 3pm-4:20pm in WNGR 304 - Weniger Hall 304 (9/23 to 12/4)
